jobs.description:
Our client is an international organisation operating within the consumer goods and retail sector.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

• Participate in purchasing and commercial projects with a focus on value creation and business performance.
• Coordinate and facilitate discussions between various stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
• Support negotiations, prepare relevant documentation and follow up on agreed actions.
• Analyse data and market insights to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
• Prepare presentations, reports and recommendations for management and project teams.
• Contribute to innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure effective communication and collaboration across all parties involved.
• Support the implementation and monitoring of strategic business initiatives.

Successful Candidate Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related field.
• 2-5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, FMCG, retail, category management, account management, commercial, or project management roles.
• Strong business acumen with an interest in purchasing, negotiations, and strategic stakeholder management.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and manage multiple stakeholders.
• Advanced Excel skills and a data-driven mindset.
• Pragmatic, proactive, relationship-oriented, and comfortable operating in an international environment.
• Fluent in French and English; additional languages such as Dutch or German are a plus.

jobs.occupation: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
• Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
• Collective dismissals
• Employment regulations and policies
• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
• Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
• Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
• Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
• Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.
• Autonomous, confident, and able to express ideas proactively.
• Entrepreneurial attitude demonstrated through professional, academic, or extracurricular initiatives.
• International exposure or an additional relevant master's degree is considered a plus.
• Team player who thrives in a collaborative and non-competitive culture.

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.

Jobomschrijving

1. Waste data and performance improvement - approximately 60-80% of the time

• Take ownership of the waste topic and improve the reliability of existing data.
• Analyse and reconcile datasets, primarily using Excel, to identify inconsistencies,gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Interview key stakeholders and data owners to understand data sources, processesand challenges.

Our client is a well-established international organization operating within a complex retail and logistics environment. Technology plays a central role in supporting business operations, and the company is investing in delivering a high-quality IT support experience to its internal users.The position is based in the Dilbeek area.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Service Desk Support Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

• Acting as the first point of contact for IT incidents and service requests.
• Logging, categorizing, prioritizing, and managing tickets through the ITSM platform.
• Performing first-line troubleshooting and resolving technical issues whenever possible.
• Supporting end-user devices, including laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and standard business applications.
• Assisting users with Microsoft 365 tools, Windows environments, user account administration, and connectivity issues.
• Managing and monitoring tickets through to resolution while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Escalating incidents to second-line support teams, external providers, or specialist teams when required.
• Following up on escalated incidents and ensuring timely resolution.
• Documenting solutions, workarounds, and recurring incidents to enrich the knowledge base.
• Collaborating with IT colleagues to improve processes, service quality, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will possess:

• Professional proficiency in French and Dutch, both written and spoken.
• A working knowledge of English for internal communication.
• Previous experience in IT support, service desk, helpdesk, or end-user support functions.
• Exposure to several of the following technologies:
• Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel)
• Windows environments and first-level troubleshooting
• Active Directory and user administration
• Networking and connectivity fundamentals
• End-user hardware and peripherals
• Mobile device support
• Strong customer service and communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills with a structured approach to ticket management.
• Analytical problem-solving capabilities and the ability to prioritize effectively.
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a genuine desire to develop technical skills further.

Our client is a specialized healthcare organization focused on developing and commercializing innovative therapies for complex diseases. The business combines scientific expertise, patient focus and ambitious growth objectives within a collaborative international environment.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Brand Manager Pharma RX - Rare Diseases - Belux your responsibilities are:

• Develop and execute local brand strategies for the rare diseases portfolio aligned with global priorities
• Lead cross-functional projects to support Pharma RX portfolio across commercial, medical and market access teams
• Translate scientific data into impactful customer engagement initiatives targeting HCPs
• Translate business priorities into practical marketing activities and clear actions.
• Plan and deliver product launches, campaigns, events and educational activities for HCPs
• Manage brand positioning to ensure consistent communication across relevant materials.
• Localize global marketing materials for the BeLux market
• Analyze market trends, customer insights and business performance
• Manage external agencies and marketing partners
• Manage project timelines and budgets linked to agreed brand activities.

As a successful Brand Manager Pharma RX - Rare Diseases - Belux you have the following profile:

• Master's degree or equivalent in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, Business or related field
• Minimum 3 years' experience in pharmaceutical brand management, product management or a comparable marketing role
• Previous marketing experiences with Pharma RX portfolio and interactions with HCPs
• Strong scientific understanding combined with commercial acumen
• Able to translate complex clinical information into practical business actions
• Proven stakeholder management and project leadership skills
• Autonomous, proactive and solution-oriented mindset
• Comfortable working in a small, agile affiliate structure

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8  years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer - Brussels - Venture Capital Firm
jobs.description:

Jobomschrijving

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of the compliance and risk framework
• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of new regulatory requirements
• Oversee AML/CFT activities and participate in related control and reporting processes
• Support interactions with regulators, supervisory authorities and regulatory filings
• Assess and monitor outsourced service providers and ICT-related risks
• Provide compliance support across fund operations, including investment monitoring and conflict assessments
• Participate in regulatory analyses supporting new jurisdictions, fundraising activities and cross-border operations

• Master's degree in Law, Finance or a related field
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar Compliance position
• Experience within an AIFM, investment fund, private equity, venture capital, asset management or another regulated financial services organisation
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are valuable assets
• Strong knowledge of financial regulations, compliance controls and risk management practices
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and apply evolving regulatory requirements
• Excellent communication skills and ability to interact with multiple internal and external stakeholders

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.
